snippet.title: We Fixed What You Hated About Bodycam | Devlog [4/4]
snippet.description:
🎮 Play Bodycam on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406770/Bodycam/

Hey everyone!

Welcome to the fourth and final devlog of our Locked & Loaded series!

This one is a little different. It is less about flashy new gameplay features and more about all the improvements you, our community, have been asking for.

Of course, this subject is almost endless. There are still many things we wanted to include but simply did not have enough time to finish for this update, but this is already a huge step forward compared to the original game.

Tomorrow, some of you will finally experience the update two days early! This beta will help us identify and fix the most important issues before the full release. With an update this big, expect some bugs and thank you in advance for helping us find them!

And finally, subscribe to our YouTube channel! We are aiming for 100K subscribers, with more Shorts and the official launch trailer coming very soon.

Thank you for following this devlog series.

If you want to have a chance to see your clip on our networks, share it on the networks using #bodycam or #bodycamgame 🔥
